practice.title: Sensitivity check: Component selection
steps: Solve one baseline case for Component selection and record every input you assumed.
Vary the two most influential inputs and re-solve.
Report how sensitive the result is, and the design margin you would recommend.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on Component selection for PCB Design. Finish it by checking that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.

outcomes: Working schematic, plots, and a test/measurement log.

extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
